description: Read one published creator search by its slug or its term, as the web app's /search/{slug} page shows it: path, term, and creators, the creators saved with it that the catalog still serves, in the shape search_creators returns: bios and captions cut to 150 characters, the website link as written or null past 200 characters, and every other link a short link that redirects for 24 hours. Reading it runs no search and spends nothing. A slug no published search has returns not_found. Works without a credential.
